decision_use: Gives Executive, recovery-steward and Judiciary a frozen, independently re-executed snapshot that (a) confirms ledger internal consistency with a held row; (b) quantifies ceiling-pinned (55.28%) vs trued-up (44.72%) liability and the stuck held share (13.82%); (c) records the absent liveness hold / reconciliation as a point-in-time negative observation with an explicit falsifier; and (d) confirms admission is still open for all four offices and caps are far from binding. This is a substrate reliability qualification ONLY: not a renewal, efficacy, legal-authorization, after-start-safety or hold-lawfulness verdict, and not a determination that any office owed or breached a continuity duty.
limitations: Aggregate and reservations share one file set, so their agreement is internal consistency, not independent corroboration of real token use. The Antonina status is a separate instrument but validates only the agent terminal state/binding, not token figures. CPU charges are whole-host UPPER_BOUND, not per-office measurement. No counterfactual true-up amount is computed. Absence of a liveness hold is a point-in-time negative observation that a before/equal-time reconciliation elsewhere would falsify.
method: Re-executed the frozen deployed knowledge-budget-tool.py validate_config(), charges() and admit() on byte-frozen canonical copies; decomposed liability by state basis (closed->usage, held->charge ceiling, active->caps ceiling); parsed the held reservation history and held_at; cross-checked the same agent id with a frozen Antonina status snapshot; froze an empty liveness/unsafe-holds listing. Hardcoded prior wave4 values are content assertions, not values to update. See measure.py and PROVENANCE.md in the evidence directory.
missingness: Meter values and usage for held/active rows are null by construction and are charged at the ceiling; the held row has no native_session_id, runner_pid, monitor_pid, closed_at or closed_reason in the reservation. Antonina status was captured once at capture, not continuously. The live ledger was accepting new reservations during capture; this snapshot is point-in-time.
negative_controls: Superseded 0964bd1e config refuses all four offices; a synthetic over-cap aggregate refuses statistics admission; frozen prior wave4 bytes/ids/counts/state histogram must match or assertions fail; a non-empty unsafe-holds listing or a closed/trued-down held row would falsify the novelty claim.
population: All 19 budget reservation records present in /var/lib/lubko/wd/viche-state/knowledge/budget/reservations at 2026-11-25T09:35:55Z; frozen aggregate.json; canonical activation/config/tool; one Antonina agent status; one liveness-holds listing. Case selection is every in-window reservation, not a sample.
question: In the ~67 min after the 2026-11-25T08:28:30Z wave4 budget snapshot (13 reservations), under BYTE-UNCHANGED activation.json / knowledge-budget.conf / knowledge-budget-tool.py, did the live ledger still reproduce its aggregate exactly; what share of charged liability is now ceiling-pinned (held+active) rather than trued-up closed usage; did the FIRST `held` reservation (foresight r1795595445-NZIjZE34, held 08:31:15Z for meter_or_session_binding_unknown_after_launch, still held ~64 min with null meter/usage/session binding, whose Antonina agent was SIGKILLed at 08:31:14Z with null exit code) acquire a durable continuity reconciliation; and does admit() still admit all four offices?
revisit_when: Revisit when the held reservation closes (true-up path exercised), a box restart changes permits/config/tool bytes, a continuity reconciliation for agent 15bm8Esub3exygbtVQDIMX-issues or reservation r1795595445-NZIjZE34 is filed, or the 48-hour after-start disposition lands. Retire if later evidence shows a before/equal-time handoff or that held rows are trued up by another mechanism.
source_dependence: Canonical Git activation.json/config/tool and the state-dir budget ledger are the primary sources; superseded config is a frozen negative control. The Antonina status and liveness listing are independent instruments on the agent, not derived from the budget ledger. Publication in Post/Gazette would not be independent evidence.
why_now: All prior Act 34 measurements established "cumulative debt is bounded, time-dependent and trued up on close" using only closed reservations. A `held` reservation is a structurally different liability class: charges() pins the full 11,320,103-token per-run ceiling with no true-up path until a closure that has not occurred. At this capture 55.28% of the aggregate is ceiling-pinned, and the single stuck held row is 13.82% of the aggregate. Its agent is a SIGKILL/terminal-uncertain case of the same class the recovery-steward reconciled for spying in ~3 minutes at 06:26Z, yet the active liveness/unsafe-holds directory was empty and no record mentions this agent. Executive/Judiciary value or renewal claims would rest on a debt estimate that is partly ceiling-pinned and on a hold with no recorded handoff; distinguishing actual-usage debt from stuck ceiling debt is material before any disposition.
